blocks.content: The HTML shell applies restrictive CSP including connect-src 'none', form-action 'none', and base-uri 'none' (the last two added 2026-10 — neither falls back to default-src, and both close injection paths like submittable phishing forms and <base> hijacks). This blocks page fetch/WebSocket-style connections, not all navigation or privileged IPC/child-process effects. See OSR-01 before treating CSP as complete isolation. .gitignore excludes dependencies, compiled outputs, releases, and OS metadata; exclusions do not establish clean Git history.
Restricts page connection APIs; does not sandbox the privileged host or its child processes.
